name: Integrated Child Development Services Scheme
benefit: **The ICDS Scheme offers a package of six services,** 1. Supplementary nutrition. 1. Immunization. 1. Health check-up. 1. Referral services. 1. Pre-school non-formal education and 1. Nutrition & Health Education.
_eligibility_text: **Eligible beneficiaries under this scheme include:** 1. Children up to 6 years of age 1. Pregnant women 1. Lactating mothers 1. Adolescent girls (14–18 years)
